body_markdown:
***Utilizing a storage unit during wedding planning keeps décor, signage, folding tables, linens, and supplies together and organized before and after the celebration.** Keeping these items in a dedicated self-storage unit or area of your existing unit keeps your home and mind clear of clutter.*


*Wedding supplies and gifts often arrive weeks or months before the event. Instead of filling closets and spare rooms with boxes, build an organized storage plan that supports setup, cleanup, returns, and future use.*


## **The Basics**


- Store wedding items in labeled bins organized by event—ceremony, reception, welcome table, photo booth, etc.


- Make sure items are clean before packing.


- Opt for a unit with Drive-Up Access for folding tables, larger décor, and frequent loading.


- Enjoy Public Storage’s month-to-month agreements while you organize supplies before and after the celebration.


**Store Wedding Supplies in One Place & Out of Sight**


**Use a self-storage unit to store wedding supplies in one central location.** Having one


place to corral wedding items keeps décor, linens, and event materials from spreading across your home, garage, vehicle, and family members’ homes and gives all key players access when needed.


Pack away items such as:


- Table decor, runners, napkins, and other linens


- Folding tables and chairs


- Welcome signs, directional signs, and seating displays


- Artificial flowers, vases, candleholders, and centerpieces


- Backdrops, arches, stands, and display pieces


- Photo-booth props and décor


- Favor bags, place cards, menus, and stationery supplies


- Empty drink dispensers, serving trays, and assorted décor containers


Organize


clean, dry supplies that you will use for setup, cleanup, returns, or future events. Do not store food, beverages, perishables, wet items, live plants, cleaners, fuel, propane, or hazardous materials in a self-storage unit.


Having your wedding items tucked away in an off-site space allows the bride and others helping with party planning to keep their mind clear. A cluttered space leads to a cluttered mind, and it’s important to keep yourself free from distraction during this special time in your life.


### **Organize Wedding Décor**


**Sorting wedding décor by event and party use speeds up setup and simplifies cleanup.** Pack each group into a labeled bin, box, or bag, then keep the related supplies together.


**Event Area & Supply Type**


**Packing Approach**


Ceremony Décor & Signage


Pack signs, aisle décor, programs, stands, and setup supplies together


Reception Tables & Linens


Fold clean, dry linens, then label bins by table type or color


Welcome Table & Guest Area


Group signs, display pieces, pens, and table décor in one container


Photo Booth & Backdrops


Bundle backdrop stands, fabric panels, props, and hardware together


Centerpieces & Vases


Wrap breakable pieces, pack them in sturdy containers, and label by table count


Setup Tools & Hardware


Store zip ties, clips, tape, batteries, and assembly hardware in a clearly labeled bin


Label every container with its contents, event area, and setup date. For example, label a container “Reception Tables — Linen Napkins — 12 Tables,” rather than “Wedding Supplies.” An inventory list helps planners, family members, and vendors locate supplies without opening every container if multiple people have access to the unit.


### **Pack Wedding Linens & Décor Carefully**


**Packing wedding linens and décor carefully keeps supplies organized and ready for event setup.** Wash and dry linens fully before folding them, then place them in clean, labeled bins or breathable fabric bags.


Use these packing steps:


- Fold tablecloths, runners, napkins, and fabric backdrops by size or color. Folding carefully reduces the time needed to prep tables during setup.


- Wrap vases, candleholders, and other breakable décor with packing paper or bubble wrap.


- Store heavier boxes on the floor, and stack lighter containers on top.


- Put hardware in labeled bags, then attach each bag to its matching display, stand, or backdrop.


- Be sure to organize boxes with the items for the first event at the front of the unit and later events toward the back. Leave an aisle from the unit entrance to the back wall.


### **Choose the Right Self-Storage Unit Size**


**Choosing the right self-storage unit size starts with measuring folding tables and listing larger display pieces and items, counting bins, and deciding how much room you need to move around items the unit.** The right unit depends on the amount of décor, linens, furniture, and supplies you plan to pack away added to the space you’ll want for walkways and aisles.


**Unit Size & Event Supplies**


**Typical Fit**


**5′ x 5′**


Bins of décor, linens, signage, and smaller display items


**5′ x 10′**


Multiple décor bins, folding tables, linens, and event supplies


**10′ x 10′**


Larger décor collections, table setups, backdrops, and supplies for a larger event


**10′ x 15′ or Larger**


Extensive event décor, multiple folding tables, larger displays, and post-event supplies


The


[Public Storage Size Guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) compares common unit sizes and helps you choose a unit that fits your event plan and needs.


### **Opt for a Unit with Drive-Up Access for Larger Supplies**


**Drive-Up Access streamlines loading folding tables, larger décor pieces, display stands, and heavy event-supply bins.** Many wedding display items are bulky and are often fragile, so having your vehicle near select ground-level units and reducing the distance between your vehicle and the storage space is convenient.


More than 45% of Public Storage properties offer Drive-Up Access, making it easy to find a location close to you. Explore


[Drive-Up Access storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/drive-up-storage) when your wedding plans involve frequent supply pickups/dropoffs and/or large event materials.


### **Keep Storage Flexible Before & After the Wedding**


**Month-to-month self-storage agreements at Public Storage allow you to keep your rental timeline aligned with your wedding-planning timeline.** Reserve a unit as supplies begin arriving, use it during setup and cleanup, then end the rental after you sort, return, donate, or pack away remaining materials.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **Where Should I Store My Wedding Décor Before the Event?**


**You should store your wedding décor before the event in a storage unit using labeled bins organized by the event and use.** A self-storage unit gives you and your party helpers and planners one central place to pack away supplies while keeping your home and planning area less crowded.


### **What Wedding Supplies Can I Put in a Self-Storage Unit?**


**You can put clean, dry wedding décor, linens, folding tables, signs, backdrop stands, vases, centerpieces, and non-perishable event supplies in a self-storage unit.** Keep food, beverages, perishables, wet items, live plants, cleaners, fuel, propane, and hazardous materials out of the unit.


### **What Size Self-Storage Unit Should I Rent for Wedding Supplies?**


**You should choose a self-storage unit size by counting bins, measuring folding tables and larger décor, and estimating how often you plan to access supplies.** A 5′ x 5′ unit fits smaller décor collections, while a 5′ x 10′ or 10′ x 10′ unit fits more extensive supplies. Use the


[Public Storage Size Guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) to compare options.


### **Should I Choose Drive-Up Access for My Wedding Supplies?**


**You should choose Drive-Up Access for wedding supplies when you plan to load folding tables, larger display pieces, backdrops, or heavy bins.** Drive-Up Access places your vehicle near your ground-level unit and streamlines loading items.


### **Can I Rent Wedding Storage for Only a Few Months?**


**You can rent wedding storage for only a few months through Public Storage’s month-to-month rental agreements.** This flexibility lets you reserve storage during planning, setup, and cleanup without a long-term rental commitment.
